beats.text: Trafalgar, 1805. You're 12 years old, and the cannons are already firing.

scene.src: commons:John Christian Schetky - The Battle of Trafalgar - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: You're a powder monkey. You run gunpowder from the magazine to the guns.
The magazine sits below the waterline, lined with copper. One spark could blow up the ship.
HMS Victory carries 104 guns. Each one needs powder, again and again.

scene.src: commons:Kanonnendek van de HMS Victory Lower deck (gun deck) (titel op object), RP-F-2001-7-228-5 (cropped).jpg

beats.text: Danger one: splinters. Cannonballs turn wood into flying daggers.
Danger two: recoil. Every gun slams backwards when it fires.
By evening, about 450 British sailors are dead. But the fleet wins.

scene.src: commons:The Battle of Trafalgar, 21 October 1805 RMG L8148-001.jpg

beats.text: Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
